lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Shot it, shot 'em and I couldn't watch.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Brendan, we're in the bedroom yet, OK? (Brendan nods “yes”) She's handcuffed yet right? (Brendan nods “yes”) And you're tellin' me if, obviously correct me if I'm wrong, what we heard. (Brendan nods “yes”) While she's handcuffed and alive, he stabs her.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Chokes her? Right? (Brendan nods “yes”) Is that right?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: And then he has you cut her neck?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: And then you cut some hair off. (Brendan nods “yes”) Is it after that, that she, does she look like she's dead then? Or is she not dead?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: You don't, do you see any breathing left?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Is it then that you take the handcuffs off, and tie her up?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: You can remember. So you think after she, she looks like she's dead then you, you guys tie her up? (Brendan nods “yes”) Then what do you do? How do you get her outside? Is this when you carry her? (Brendan nods “yes”) When you say you carried her?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: What part of her body did you carry?
